blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Traffic Enforcement Agency of Mandaue (TEAM) is summoning a motorist caught on video allowing a child to kneel while riding as a back rider on a motorcycle in Barangay Tawason on Monday afternoon, November 16. TEAM head Hyll Retuya, in an interview on Wednesday, November 18, said the incident, which circulated on social media, raised serious road safety concerns as it placed the child’s life at risk. Retuya said he intends to locate and summon the driver to the agency’s office to give him an opportunity to explain his actions before the matter is endorsed to […]...
